availability.reason: ElevenLabs blocks Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, Crimea, Donetsk, and Luhansk.

description: ElevenLabs native audio platform for text-to-speech, Scribe transcription, music composition, voice design and voice lifecycle APIs.
residency_notes: ElevenLabs says standard customer data is hosted in the US, with enterprise isolated environments for the EU, India, and Singapore. Its default API uses global routing with current backend regions including the US, Netherlands, and Singapore. Processing can still occur outside a selected storage region unless the relevant residency and Zero Retention Mode/API restrictions apply.
prompt_training_notes: ElevenLabs says enterprise customer data is not used to improve models by default, and other users can opt out of model-improvement data use. Zero Retention Mode is a separate optional enterprise control; default retention remains enabled for supported products unless it is configured.

sources.notes: Current TTS, Scribe v2, realtime Scribe and Music v1/v2 models and per-model character limits.

verification.notes: Native TTS, batch Scribe V2 transcription and Music V2 composition routes are active. Realtime Scribe and voice transformation/design APIs use contracts that are not currently exposed by the gateway and remain catalog-only.
